names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 15 ноября ст. ст., name page 9835, «Никита (Алмазов), протодиакон, сщмч.», with the grade word and the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Никиты» and gives it without a surname. No other folder holds this form. The line calls the two of them «диаконов» together, while his own name page gives the fuller grade «протодиакон»; the page is the fuller reading of the same thing and the office is written from it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Николая и Петра пресвитеров, Григория и Никиты диаконов (1937).»

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 15 ноября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page, so that year is the whole of what is recorded here; no day, no place and no manner of death are given, and none is inferred.
